Product Details: UTL ShineX 3.2 kW On-Grid Rooftop Solar Kit (Single Phase) with DCR TOPCon Bi-Facial Panels, 6×525W Modules, PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana Subsidy Eligible, Complete All-in-One Solution - Distributed/Packaged by Utl. Product Details: Reduced Electricity Bills Generate your own clean electricity and significantly reduce monthly power bills. The 3.2 kW on-grid system efficiently offsets daytime electricity consumption, making it ideal for Indian residential homes. PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana – Subsidy Eligible This solar kit is eligible for up to ₹78,000 central government subsidy under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (for systems 3 kW–10 kW). Uses DCR-compliant TOPCon Bi-Facial panels as per scheme guidelines. High-Efficiency DCR TOPCon Bi-Facial Panels Equipped with 6 × 525W DCR TOPCon Bi-Facial solar panels, designed for higher energy yield, better low-light performance, and long-term durability with up to 27 years performance warranty. Complete All-in-One Solar Kit Includes on-grid inverter, ACDB, DCDB, MC4 connectors, DC & AC cables, earthing accessories, lightning arrestor, and electrical BOS components—engineered for safe, compliant, and hassle-free installation. Reliable On-Grid System with Net Metering Support Single-phase on-grid system with net metering support, allowing excess solar power to be exported to the grid, ensuring maximum savings and efficient energy utilization.
